column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Dad Is Thickheaded
I'm asking if that's really true.
I-I'm telling the truth!
...Dad, I'm the same as always, aren't I? I'm not being strange or anything, right?
...That goes without saying.
For you to say such words to me is the most concrete evidence that you are lost.
You look like you've been forcing yourself recently.
That could be the case... Kirino does force herself.
E-Even you... Don't say unnecessary things!
I'm not forcing myself!
Then why won't you look me in the eye while talking?
I have the same feeling.
I-I'm not forcing myself. A-Aren't I the same as always?
Then why won't you look me in the eye while talking?
Kirino, is there something troubling you?
T-That's...
Is it something you can't tell even me?
Dad.
What is it, Kyousuke?
Let me think of a solution for Kirino's troubles.
That's why, rest assured.
H-Huh? I don't want you to...
Is that so, then I'll leave it to you.
Ehh?!
...Yes, I can't tell... even you, Dad, about this.
Is that so... Well then, consult Kyousuke about it.
Ehh?
Ehh?!
D-Dad?! What are you saying?!
Kyousuke has been more concerned about you than anyone else in the family during this year.
Protecting his little sister using methods that I can't.
You should know that very well.
T-That's just...
I've decided to leave all matters concerning Kirino to Kyousuke.
...That is all.
...A-About you... protecting me, is it true?
Who knows.
I've merely done what I wanted to do, just like always.
